note: Recast from the original description of the new species by Ahmad (1965), the original in English; the large soldier and the small soldier are described separately, and the alate and worker are not described. Figure 21 (large soldier: head and pronotum, head in lateral view, mandibles, postmentum) and figure 22 (small soldier, the same views, and antenna) are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Large soldier: head reddish yellow, the margin of the fontanelle, the two sides of the frontal groove, the posterior margin of the postclypeus and the antennal carinae red; anteclypeus white; labrum concolorous with the head; mandibles reddish brown, paler at the base; antenna pale yellowish brown; pronotum and abdomen yellow; legs pale. Head hairless; labral tip with a row of short hairs; pronotum with a few microchaetae in the middle of the anterior margin only, otherwise bare. Head somewhat rectangular, the lateral margins almost parallel in front of the antennae and then narrowing towards the mandibular bases; fontanelle round, with a groove extending forward to the anteclypeus. Postclypeus very narrow, much wider than long, with a median groove. Labrum about as long as wide, widest in the basal third; anterior margin wide and slightly concave at the middle, transparent; lateral lobes broadly rounded. Mandibles stout; left mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the first 0.21—0.23 mm from the apical tooth; right mandible with 1 sharp marginal tooth. Postmentum slightly arched, the anterior width 1.5 times the posterior width; the waist situated about halfway between the widest part and the lower margin. Antenna 16 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 4 the shortest. Pronotum with the middle of the anterior margin projecting, the lateral lobes broadly rounded, the posterior margin slightly concave. Measurements of 10 large soldiers (holotype/range/mean): head length (to the lateral mandibular bases) 1.37/1.30—1.43/1.40 mm; head width (at the mandibular bases) 0.91/0.62—0.93/0.86 mm; head width at the posterolateral ends of the antennal carinae 1.17/1.14—1.24/1.18 mm; head width at the middle 1.19/1.14—1.24/1.20 mm; left mandible length 0.78/0.72—0.81/0.77 mm; postmentum length 1.04/1.01—1.07/1.04 mm; maximum postmentum width 0.39/0.37—0.41/0.39 mm; minimum postmentum width 0.23/0.22—0.24/0.23 mm; pronotum length 0.41/0.39—0.42/0.41 mm; pronotum width 0.70/0.65—0.75/0.71 mm; mesonotum width 0.65/0.65—0.70/0.66 mm; metanotum width 0.75/0.72—0.78/0.75 mm.

Small soldier: head yellow with a reddish tinge; the opening of the fontanelle, the posterior margin of the postclypeus and the antennal carinae reddish brown; postclypeus and labrum slightly paler than the head; mandibles pale reddish brown, yellow at the base; antenna brownish yellow; pronotum yellow. The posterior third of the head has one pair of setae, and there is another pair slightly in front of the middle; labral tip with a row of short hairs; pronotum with 2 long setae near the posterior margin, 1 on each lateral lobe, and a few shorter setae on the anterior margin. Head widest at the posterolateral ends of the antennal carinae, the lateral margins narrowing posteriorly; fontanelle very small and round, its anterior groove wider than the fontanelle. Postclypeus much wider than long, with a median groove. Labrum long, slightly beyond the mandibular tips; tip bilobed. Mandibles slender, incurved at the tip; left mandible with 2 sharp marginal teeth, the first 0.10—0.13 mm from the apical tooth; right mandible with 1 marginal tooth, whose distance from the apical tooth is slightly greater than that of the first marginal tooth of the left mandible. Postmentum strongly arched, the anterior part only slightly wider than the waist; the waist near the posterior margin, not halfway between the widest part and the lower margin. Antenna 15 segments; segment 2 is 1.5 times the length of segment 3; segment 4 slightly longer than segments 3 and 5. Pronotum with broadly rounded lateral margins, the posterior margin very weakly concave. Measurements of 7 small soldiers (morphotype/range/mean): head length (to the lateral mandibular bases) 0.70/0.67—0.78/0.72 mm; head width (at the mandibular bases) 0.46/0.44—0.52/0.46 mm; head width at the posterolateral ends of the antennal carinae 0.67/0.62—0.79/0.68 mm; head width at the middle 0.65/0.59—0.70/0.64 mm; left mandible length 0.57/0.55—0.62/0.57 mm; postmentum length 0.52/0.49—0.57/0.52 mm; maximum postmentum width 0.26/0.26—0.29/0.27 mm; minimum postmentum width 0.20/0.20—0.26/0.22 mm; pronotum length 0.31/0.29—0.36/0.33 mm; pronotum width 0.49/0.45—0.59/0.49 mm; mesonotum width 0.46/0.44—0.62/0.49 mm; metanotum width 0.49/0.49—0.65/0.59 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The large soldier is close in size to Schedorhinotermes makassarensis, but the head is somewhat rectangular (subquadrate in the latter); javanicus, medioobscurus and longirostris are larger, and their heads are also subquadrate. The diagnostic characters of the small soldier are the head shape, the margin of the fontanelle and the two sides of the postmentum given above.
